name: GoHighLevel
one_liner: GoHighLevel is an all‑in‑one marketing and CRM platform with API access for private integrations and MCP.
auth_notes: Uses Private Integration Tokens (Bearer) for API v2; OAuth 2.0 is also supported for multi‑client installations.
access_notes: API credentials can be generated directly from the account settings; no approval required.
blocker: trial only, no free tier for credentials

extras.rate_limits: Burst Limit: 25 requests per 10 seconds, Daily Limit: 10,000 requests

evidence.snippet: Generate Private Integration tokens from your account settings and manage them with ease.

curl --request GET \
  --url https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/locations/ve9EPM428h8vShlRW1KT \
  --header 'Accept: application/json' \
  --header 'Authorization: <YOUR PRIVATE INTEGRATION TOKEN>' \
  --header 'Version: 2021-07-28'
visit our official API documentation: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/
The HighLevel MCP Server lets AI agents and MCP-compatible clients connect securely to HighLevel tools and services.
We’ve enabled Private Integration Tokens (PITs) for Sandbox and Trial accounts, allowing developers and agencies to test their custom integrations end-to-end against HighLevel APIs before going live.

notes: API v2 uses Private Integration Tokens (Bearer) for server‑to‑server access; OAuth 2.0 is recommended for multi‑client marketplace apps. No app review is required to obtain credentials, but token scopes must be set appropriately.
